svg.title: A fox follows a paper road
svg.desc: The supplied orange fox reaches toward a curled paper sheet on a sage workbench. The sheet unfolds into a winding road with a small orange car. Faithful web derivative of FoxHomepage_0.svg: all 176 paths, one ellipse, 19 gradients and original painting order are retained. The source AI, SVG and source provenance metadata remain unchanged in IllustratorWorkspace.
